recordStage: Actual native/mobile/card review complete; normal verification, required CI and actual merge remain separate gates.
setup: Sit against the back pad and hold the side handles.
Place both feet on the plate; keep heels supported.
Control the return and stop before your back rounds.

advice.tip: Keep your back supported and press through both feet without snapping your knees straight.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back off the pad.
Lifting the heels off the plate.
